Founded on a simple premise: people everywhere, regardless of identity or circumstances, should have the chance to live healthy, productive lives. Investments Are Made In Support Of The Charitable Impact Theses Of The Strategy Teams Which Employ Technical Experts From Around The World. Representative Past Investments From The Fund Include $11 million Series A preferred equity investment in bKash, Ltd., the largest mobile payments platform in Bangladesh serving more than 80 million unique customers across 500M monthly transactions. $55 million Series B preferred equity investment in BioNTech SE, a commercial biotechnology company developing immunotherapies for cancer and mRNA vaccines for infectious disease (IPO September 2019). +$300 million combined volume guarantees to Mylan Laboratories and Aurobindo Pharma to support the introduction and supply of new HIV drugs at affordable prices in low-income countries. €10 million Series C preferred equity investment in Aphea.Bio, an agricultural biotechnology company developing crop biostimulant and biocontrol/protection products. $5 million Series B preferred equity investment in Pula, a leading insurtech company providing risk protection to over 4 million famers annually across Africa; and $300 million loan to Gavi and the Serum Institute of India to support scale-up of COVID-19 vaccines for low and middle-income countries. Investments from the fund are structured as “program-related investments,” which is a defined term in the US Internal Revenue Code that governs charitable investments made by private foundations. Join deal teams that include program technical experts, legal and investment colleagues to execute new investments, including: performing initial evaluation, participating in shaping conversations with company, determining investment structuring, leading the due diligence process and financial modeling, and negotiating definitive legal documentation. Present investments to the foundation's Investment Committee. Participate in all aspects of portfolio management, potentially including as an observer of the board of directors, through facilitating interactions between portfolio companies and foundation program teams, proactively identifying and mitigating key strategic, financial, and legal opportunities/issues and ensuring that the Investment Committee and leadership are informed on the impact/financial performance across the portfolio. Ensure high-quality interactions and provide clear and consistent communications with internal and external stakeholders. Your Experience We anticipate that the successful candidate will be an Analyst, Associate or Principal from a venture capital, growth equity, leveraged buy-out fund, investment bank or strategy consulting firm. The candidate should have meaningful experience in identifying and/or assessing investment opportunities, conducting commercial and financial due diligence, supporting transaction execution and building trusted relationships with founders, management teams and C-level executives. The candidate should have a strong interest in principal investing, intellectual curiosity, sound commercial judgement and a genuine commitment to the foundation’s mission of advancing innovative and scalable approaches to social impact. Other Attributes Comfortable in a wide range of cultural, geographic and operational situations, demonstrating culturally sensitive behaviour with a diverse range of people and a deep commitment to development issues and high standards of personal integrity. Ability to travel up to 25% internationally. Must be able to legally work in the country where this position is located without visa sponsorship. Application deadline: 30 September 2026 Hiring Requirements As part of our standard hiring process for new employees, employment will be contingent upon successful completion of a background check.
